item.title: Unsafe Hoardings Across Cities: Here’s How To Get Them Removed as Per The Law
item.description: Despite laws, court directives and civic drives, illegal and hazardous hoardings continue to endanger lives, revealing deep enforcement and accountability gaps in Indian cities.

item.title: Ajmer’s Sufiya Sufi Breaks Guinness World Record, Completes 480 km Manali-Leh Run in Historic 98.2 Hours
item.description: Indian ultra-marathoner Sufiya Sufi has set a Guinness World Record by completing the 480-km Manali–Leh route in just 98 hours despite extreme Himalayan conditions.

item.title: Odisha: Male Warden Accused of Sexually Abusing Several Disabled Students at Government School
item.description: Students at a government-run school for the deaf, mute and blind in Odisha have accused their warden of sexual and physical abuse, prompting an official investigation.

item.title: India-U.S. Trade Deal: Trump Cuts India Tariffs in Historic Pact, Says Modi Will Stop Buying Russian Oil
item.description: India-US Trade Deal: In a historic pivot, India secures a major trade deal, slashing US tariffs to eighteen per cent.

item.title: India–US Trade Deal Boosts Markets: Rupee Jumps 119 Paise to 90.3 in Early Trade
item.description: A long-awaited India–US trade agreement lifted investor confidence, strengthening the rupee and sparking a sharp rally across Indian markets.

item.title: Bengaluru Horror: 65-Year-Old Woman Allegedly Raped, Murdered at Home by Domestic Help; Accused Found Dead, Probe On
item.description: Police say the accused died by suicide after the crime, sparking urgent concerns over elderly safety and domestic worker verification.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty Hit Record Highs as Historic India-U.S. Trade Deal Boosts Markets
item.description: In a historic pivot, India secures a major trade deal, slashing US tariffs to eighteen per cent. Let's look at the market post India-US deal.

item.description: LeafyLeather transforms agricultural waste into eco-friendly leather alternatives, prioritising sustainability and purpose over profit.
